body: INDEPENDENT INTERPRETATION: accept the sentence-0 fixture-provider wall as the first real boundary. The four-success containment errors are expected from that diagnostic's stated construction, not evidence of a compiler/hierarchy defect: the single StorySummaryAttempt comes from sentence 3, so its derived parent span is [99,124), while later membership spans necessarily escape it. By contrast, the three UnsupportedTrajectoryInputs gaps are useful positive evidence that the compiler fails closed when ParticipantRole and TemporalRelation support is absent. Recommended next decomposition: (1) widen deterministic acquisition coverage with explicit per-sentence abstention/failure artifacts, (2) add a source-level summary/hierarchy attempt rather than reuse a sentence summary, (3) add supported participant/temporal attempts, then rerun the same full-source court. No source edits or competing claim.
